page: Amazon Web Services i8ge.2xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by an 8-core AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 ARMv9 processor running at 2.8 GHz. Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, it features 8 dedicated physical cores with single-thread execution per core. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and a substantial 5000 GB local NVMe SSD storage array. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate a highly capable memory subsystem, with the Passmark memory score ranking in the top tier. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 924.76 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 189.45 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. CPU performance is generally average, with Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores of 1875.0 and 10135.0 respectively. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression is a strong point, placing in the top 25% at 14.41 GB/sec. However, cryptographic performance is a notable tradeoff, with the Passmark CPU encryption test scoring in the bottom 25%. Large language model inference capabilities are also limited, showing poor prompt processing speeds of 15.65 tokens/sec on a 7B model.

The i8ge.2xlarge offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring dense local storage and high memory bandwidth without the overhead of x86 licensing. The combination of 5000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a top-tier memory subsystem makes this instance well-suited for storage-intensive and database workloads, such as Redis deployments, which achieved 17.79 million SET operations per second in testing. It is also highly appropriate for static web serving, database operations, and memory-bound data processing tasks that can leverage the ARM64 architecture.

However, cryptographic execution and LLM inference speeds present performance tradeoffs, with weak results in encryption tests and poor prompt processing on medium models. With its high local storage capacity, 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and strong memory bandwidth, the i8ge.2xlarge is highly suited for database operations, Redis caching, and storage-intensive workloads.
